nodes.description: Owner address slot; written by initOwner and claimOwnership, read by onlyOwner.
Pending owner address; set by transferOwnership, consumed and cleared by claimOwnership.
One-time initialization flag guarding initOwner.
Unprotected initializer that sets _INITIALIZED_ and _OWNER_ to an arbitrary caller-supplied address.
onlyOwner function that stages a new pending owner in _NEW_OWNER_.
Two-step transfer acceptance; requires msg.sender == _NEW_OWNER_ and rotates _OWNER_.
Caller-controlled address used for the onlyOwner and claimOwnership authorization checks.
Caller-supplied address assigned directly into privileged state slot _OWNER_.
Owner-supplied address written into the pending-owner slot.
Global minimum fragment threshold (default 100), settable only by owner.
Global maximum fragment threshold (default 1000), settable only by owner.
Signed fee/qualification return value handed back by getBuyoutStatus.
Mapping of fragment token address to FragInfo configuration struct.
onlyOwner writer that stores a full FragInfo struct for a fragment token.
onlyOwner partial updater of an existing FragInfo entry.
onlyOwner setter for global min/max fragment and buyout fee with range validation.
View qualifier that reads token balances/supply and an external buyout contract to decide buyout eligibility.
Key address of the fragment token whose config is written.
Minimum fragment value stored into the FragInfo struct.
Maximum fragment value stored into the FragInfo struct.
External qualification contract address stored into the FragInfo struct.
Memory FragInfo constructed and copied into the frags mapping.
Key address of the fragment token whose config is mutated.
New minimum fragment value written into storage.
New maximum fragment value written into storage.
New external qualification address written into storage.
New global minimum fragment; required to be <= 1000.
New global maximum fragment; required to be <= 1000.
New fee value, cast from uint256 to int and stored in _BUYOUT_FEE_.
Caller-supplied token address used both as mapping key and as the target of external calls.
Account whose balance and qualification are queried.
Memory copy of frags[fragAddr] used to read per-token configuration.
Result of the external balanceOf call on the fragment token.
Result of the external totalSupply call on the fragment token.
Effective minimum fragment: global value, overridden by per-token config when set.
Effective maximum fragment: global value, overridden by per-token config when set.
Per-token external qualification contract address taken from FragInfo.
Boolean result returned by the external IBuyout qualification call.
External call IERC20(fragAddr).balanceOf(user) where the target address is caller-controlled.
External call IERC20(fragAddr).totalSupply() on a caller-supplied token address.
External call into owner-configured buyoutAddr contract returning a qualification flag.
Privilege-granting state write in initOwner missing any caller authorization check.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == _OWNER_ before transferOwnership executes.
claimOwnership requires msg.sender == _NEW_OWNER_ to authorize ownership rotation.
addFragInfo is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
setFragInfo is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
setGlobalParam is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
newOwner argument flows into initOwner.
Caller-supplied address is written directly into the privileged _OWNER_ slot.
newOwner argument flows into transferOwnership.
Owner-supplied address is staged in _NEW_OWNER_.
_NEW_OWNER_ is promoted into _OWNER_ during claimOwnership.
_NEW_OWNER_ is reset to address(0) after the claim.
initOwner unconditionally executes the privileged owner-assignment operation.
fragAddr is used as the mapping key for frags.
Locally built FragInfo struct is written into frags[fragAddr].
addFragInfo writes into the frags mapping.
setFragInfo mutates fields of an existing frags entry.
minFrag parameter is stored by addFragInfo.
maxFrag parameter is stored by addFragInfo.
buyoutAddr parameter is stored by addFragInfo.
minFrag parameter is written to frags[fragAddr].minFrag.
maxFrag parameter is written to frags[fragAddr].maxFrag.
buyoutAddr parameter is written to frags[fragAddr].buyoutAddr.
minFrag parameter flows into setGlobalParam validation and storage.
maxFrag parameter flows into setGlobalParam validation and storage.
buyoutFee parameter is cast to int and stored globally.
setGlobalParam writes _MIN_FRAG_.
setGlobalParam writes _MAX_FRAG_.
setGlobalParam casts and writes _BUYOUT_FEE_.
fragAddr indexes frags to populate the local FragInfo copy.
buyoutAddr is read out of the FragInfo struct.
per-token minFrag overrides the local minFrag when isSet.
per-token maxFrag overrides the local maxFrag when isSet.
Global _MIN_FRAG_ seeds the local minFrag default.
Global _MAX_FRAG_ seeds the local maxFrag default.
getBuyoutStatus invokes the external balanceOf call.
getBuyoutStatus invokes the external totalSupply call.
getBuyoutStatus conditionally invokes the external qualification call.
Caller-supplied fragAddr becomes the callee address of the balanceOf call.
user parameter is passed as the account argument of balanceOf.
Return value of balanceOf is assigned to userBalance.
Caller-supplied fragAddr becomes the callee address of the totalSupply call.
Return value of totalSupply is assigned to totalSupply local.
FragInfo.buyoutAddr is used as the target address of the external qualification call.
user parameter is forwarded to getBuyoutQualification.
Boolean returned by getBuyoutQualification is assigned to isQualified.

External call to the owner-configured buyoutAddr contract; the interface declares getBuyoutQualification as view, so it is compiled to STATICCALL and cannot re-enter state-changing logic, but the callee is still an untrusted external contract.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is a transient argument of initOwner and carries no independent security meaning.
newOwner is a transient argument of transferOwnership absorbed by the pending-owner write.
fragAddr is only the mapping key used by addFragInfo.
minFrag is a transient config argument of addFragInfo.
maxFrag is a transient config argument of addFragInfo.
buyoutAddr is a transient config argument of addFragInfo.
fragInfo is the memory structconstructed inside addFragInfo and flushed to storage immediately.
fragAddr is only the mapping key used by setFragInfo.
minFrag is a transient config argument of setFragInfo.
maxFrag is a transient config argument of setFragInfo.
buyoutAddr is a transient config argument of setFragInfo.
minFrag is validated and consumed entirely inside setGlobalParam.
maxFrag is validated and consumed entirely inside setGlobalParam.
buyoutFee is converted and stored by setGlobalParam with no separate semantics.
fragAddr is the query argument of getBuyoutStatus; its taint is already modeled by the edges into the external calls.
user is the query argument of getBuyoutStatus forwarded to the external calls.
fragInfo is a local memory copy of the frags mapping read inside getBuyoutStatus.
userBalance is purely the return buffer of the external balanceOf call.
totalSupply is purely the return buffer of the external totalSupply call.
minFrag is a temporary threshold local used only for the eligibility comparison.
maxFrag is a temporary threshold local used only for the eligibility comparison.
buyoutAddr is a temporary holder for the external qualification callee address.
isQualified is solely the boolean result of the external qualification call.
